description: A short plain-language summary of the sidereal birth chart (True Chitrapaksha ayanamsa): the rising sign, the Moon sign and nakshatra and the Sun sign, each with a one-line meaning, and the running Vimshottari life chapter and sub-chapter (month and year). Up to 3 answers per chart every 6 hours, shared with life_area and current_chapter. Birth details are used only to calculate this answer; a one-way code is kept for 6 hours to apply fair-use limits.

birth_time.description: Local birth time as recorded, 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.
